name: aijewel-crm
description: AIJewel CRM, WhatsApp, marketing, meetings, and voice-bot platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aijewel/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @aijewel/shared" "npm run dev -w @aijewel/api" "npm run dev -w @aijewel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aijewel/shared && npm run build -w @aijewel/types && npm run build -w @aijewel/api && npm run build -w @aijewel/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint -w @aijewel/shared && npm run lint -w @aijewel/api && npm run lint -w @aijewel/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aijewel/shared && npm run test:unit -w @aijewel/api
